title: Mother Holding Newborn Baby Outdoors, 1940s B&W Family Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet mid-1940s snapshot of a smiling young mother holding her swaddled newborn baby outside in the sun. The woman wears her dark hair styled in iconic 1940s victory rolls/curls and wears a short-sleeved collared shirt. They are positioned outdoors near a leafy fruit or garden tree next to a clapboard house with sun-dappled shadows.
